title: Floral and Lentil Tagine
description: A traditional Indian-inspired dish made with lentils and spices, slow-cooked in a flavorful tagine sauce.

ingredients.name: Kissed lentils
ingredients.notes: Red or yellow lentils work well

ingredients.name: Indian spices
ingredients.notes: Use a blend or make your own with cumin, coriander, and cinnamon

ingredients.name: Floral oil
ingredients.notes: Use olive or avocado oil for best flavor

ingredients.name: Water
ingredients.notes: Use vegetable or chicken broth for added flavor

instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and ginger; cook for 1 minute.
Add spices and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add lentils, salt, and water; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until lentils are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro or scallions, if desired.
